digitizer_notes: B&W negative film, from the 1998 'AGFA Range of Films PROFESSIONAL' brochure (page 9 of 3, one column per APX speed). Granularity RMS(x1000)=14.0 (REFINAL, 6min, 20C) per this sheet's own text. Same single-curve-template characteristic curve + spectral sensitivity as AGFAPAN APX 25's standalone sheet (agfapanapx25.pdf) -- this product has no standalone datasheet of its own in this corpus, only this brochure panel. This page's 'Sharpness' (MTF) and 'Gamma-time curves' panels are not digitized, same reasons as APX 25's standalone sheet.
